- Claude Code issue #54546 directly covers the clipboard/TTY-bytes constraint relevant to the dotfiles workflow decision.

The top 3 sources (two Ghostty GitHub discussions + official ghostty.org/docs/features) give authoritative CONFIRMED/MISSING support classification; akmatori blog covers the three-protocol comparison; rasterm shows detection internals.
